card.name: Punctuation ending notes and interaction statements
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a linking word right after a note label or a drug-interaction statement, such as a colon after Note or a period after a brand name. The pole fires where a further caution or instruction is about to start.

modes.label: Colon after Note
modes.description: A colon after the word Note that introduces a side remark.
modes.example: Please Note<<:>> By clicking a link to any resource listed

modes.label: End of drug interaction sentence
modes.description: A period or comma after a drug or brand name in an interaction passage.

modes.label: Linking word mid-instruction
modes.description: A word like may or but in a sentence about co-administration or reconstitution.

card.writes: It promotes 'please' and 'please contact' words, so it nudges the model toward a polite instruction next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label or note pauses and an added instruction or caution may follow.
